text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about 
with Daring Tact—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...They seem to be everywhere. 
These crane games.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes, I admit I am somewhat intrigued.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It is a game where one targets the vital 
point 
and immobilizes the prey to capture it, 
correct?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I have long thought it would serve 
as excellent hunting practice.
choice_data_list: If you're curious, why not give it a shot?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
No, I lack the necessary experience. 
I am not even confident in how to operate 
the controls...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If you wouldn't mind, 
could you demonstrate for me?
